company.description:
SkyLink is a unified travel management and collaboration platform that uses artificial intelligence to automate trip management via email and chat. SkyLink combines their client's existing technology stack and Artificial Intelligence to automate tasks in the same way that a typical TMC agent would.

SkyLink is headquartered in San Francisco, California and was founded in 2021.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,995,941 to $10,995,941, a 1x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 81 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 49 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
